# hivelocity_ip_assignment (Data Source)

Looks up one of your IP assignments (subnets) by ID, by an address it contains, or by filtering the full list (for example on `facility_code` or `subnet`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By ID
data "hivelocity_ip_assignment" "by_id" {
  assignment_id = 4321
}

# By an address inside the assignment
data "hivelocity_ip_assignment" "by_address" {
  ip_address = "66.165.231.122"
}

# By filtering the list
data "hivelocity_ip_assignment" "tampa_v6" {
  first = true
  filter {
    name   = "facility_code"
    values = ["TPA1"]
  }
  filter {
    name   = "version"
    values = ["6"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assignment_id` (Number) Look up the assignment by ID.
- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.
- `ip_address` (String) Look up the assignment containing this IP address.

### Read-Only

- `broadcast_ip` (String) Broadcast address of the subnet.
- `client_id` (Number) Owning client ID.
- `description` (String) Description of the assignment.
- `device_id` (Number) Device receiving the assignment's traffic, if any.
- `dns_resolvers` (List of String) DNS resolvers for the subnet (VPS only).
- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the assignment.
- `first_usable_ip` (String) First address usable by devices.
- `gateway_ip` (String) Gateway address of the subnet.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_usable_ip` (String) Last address usable by devices.
- `netmask` (String) Netmask of the assignment.
- `next_hop_ip` (String) Next-hop IP when the assignment is statically routed.
- `port_id` (Number) Port receiving the assignment's traffic, if any.
- `subnet` (String) CIDR representation of the assignment.
- `usable_ips` (List of String) Usable addresses (IPv4 only).
- `version` (Number) IP version (4 or 6).
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN receiving the assignment's traffic, if any.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
